name: pilot-kit
description: Development tooling for the pilot Claude Code plugin. The plugin itself has no runtime dependencies.

scripts.eval: claude plugin eval plugin --ablation with-without --runs 3 --threshold 0.8 --trust-plugin --scaffold --no-publish && node scripts/record-evals.js
scripts.check:release: npm test && npm run check:registry && npm run check:budget && claude plugin validate --strict . && claude plugin validate --strict plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json
